ev.q: In 2016 France passed a law requiring large supermarkets to donate unsold food that is still fit to eat to charities

1.why: F段。a legal duty placed on certain shops ↔ a law requiring large supermarkets to donate…。D段超市取消日期标签是商家自愿的做法，不是法律要求。

ev.q: households alone were responsible for about 61 per cent of this

2.why: A段。the proportion of waste that comes from homes ↔ households alone were responsible for about 61 per cent。B段的 8–10 per cent 是温室气体的比例，不是浪费来自家庭的比例。

ev.q: as it rots without air, it releases methane, a gas that traps far more heat in the atmosphere than carbon dioxide does

3.why: B段。contributes to global warming ↔ releases methane, a gas that traps far more heat in the atmosphere；discarded food ↔ Food that ends up in landfill sites。

ev.q: replaced the use-by dates on most of its own milk with best-before dates

4.why: D段。a business changing the information on a product ↔ Morrisons replaced the use-by dates on most of its own milk with best-before dates。E段超市低价卖“丑”蔬果改变的是价格，不是产品上的信息。

ev.q: Their diaries showed that they threw away almost twice as much as they had believed.

5.why: C段。underestimate how much they throw away ↔ threw away almost twice as much as they had believed。G段也讲 Lindqvist，但那是关于信息宣传无效，不是低估浪费。

ev.q: Some now sell such produce at a lower price, often in boxes labelled as wonky or imperfect.

6.why: E段。sold cheaply ↔ at a lower price；because of its appearance ↔ the wrong shape or size。F段 app 打折卖的是当天卖剩的食物，不是因为外观。

ev.q: most of them estimated that they wasted very little. Their diaries showed that they threw away almost twice as much as they had believed

7.why: C段。revealed a large gap between what families believed and what they did ↔ estimated that they wasted very little … threw away almost twice as much as they had believed。D 是A段联合国粮农组织的估计，不是 Lindqvist。

ev.q: most food is lost before it ever reaches a shop

8.why: E段。in some regions ↔ in poorer countries；lost long before it is sold ↔ lost before it ever reaches a shop。E 是英国超市的做法（D段），不是 Mensah。

ev.q: requiring large supermarkets to donate unsold food that is still fit to eat to charities

9.why: F段。required large stores ↔ requiring large supermarkets；pass on edible food they could not sell ↔ donate unsold food that is still fit to eat。B 是 Morrisons 的做法（D段）。

ev.q: a “use by” date is about safety, while a “best before” date is about quality

10.why: D段。relates to ↔ is about。quality 已在题干中给出，对应的是 best before。

ev.q: encouraging customers to use a “sniff test” instead of pouring milk away unnecessarily

11.why: D段末句。customers advised ↔ encouraging customers；check milk with ↔ use a sniff test instead of pouring milk away。

ev.q: Lindqvist found that information campaigns alone rarely change behaviour

12.why: G段。campaigns that only provide ___ ↔ information campaigns alone；seldom alter habits ↔ rarely change behaviour。

ev.q: Writing a shopping list before going out, checking the fridge before buying more and serving smaller portions

13.why: G段。make a ___ ↔ Writing a shopping list；check the fridge 和 serve less 已在题干中给出，对应 checking the fridge 和 serving smaller portions。
